prompt: Inside a computer, what is the motherboard's main job?

options.text: It stores all your photos permanently
It is the main circuit board that connects the processor, memory and other parts so they can work together
It turns the computer into a games console

explanation: The motherboard is the computer's main circuit board. The processor, memory and storage all plug into it, and its tracks carry signals between them — it is the meeting place that lets every part talk to the others.
